description.en: This resource represents a message that is used to communicate between two actors using the BCAP system. It is intended to replace other external communications (email, phone) or to log communication that happened outside of the system.

nodes.description: When the side that started the thread (the root's author, or all staff when a staff member started an external thread) resolved it. Set on the thread root only; empty means unresolved for that side.
nodes.name: Thread Author Resolved Date

nodes.description: Who on the author side resolved the thread. Set on the thread root only, alongside the author resolved date.
nodes.name: Thread Author Resolved By

nodes.description: When the side the thread was addressed to (the root's recipient, a group's members, or all staff when a staff member is the recipient of an external thread) resolved it. Set on the thread root only; empty means unresolved for that side.
nodes.name: Thread Recipient Resolved Date

nodes.description: Who on the recipient side resolved the thread. Set on the thread root only, alongside the recipient resolved date.
nodes.name: Thread Recipient Resolved By

nodes.description: When the thread's latest message was posted. Set on the thread root only.
nodes.name: Thread Last Message Date

nodes.description: Who is taking part in the thread: its author, its recipient (a person, company or the Archaeology Branch) and anyone else who has posted. Only they are alerted when their side is unresolved. Set on the thread root only.
nodes.name: Thread Participants

nodes.description: A resource that this message points at.
nodes.name: Resource Context

nodes.description: Whether the thread is internal (staff only) rather than shared with the applicant. Decided on the thread root; replies inherit it.
nodes.name: Is Internal

nodes.description: Whether anyone other than whoever started the thread has replied. Until then the starter is only waiting, so an open side is not theirs to action. Set on the thread root only.
nodes.name: Thread Answered

nodes.description: The thread root a reply belongs to. Empty on the root itself.
nodes.name: Thread

nodes.description: Contributors who have archived this thread (personal, per-viewer). One tile per contributor; stored on the thread root message only, so it is read/written on the root even when the action comes from a reply.
nodes.name: Archived By
